summary: ClipAura is a creative iOS video studio. Ordinary editing, captions, subject cutout, projects, and exports stay on your device. A private Firebase identity stores onboarding choices, and hosted AI receives your media only after ClipAura names the provider and you approve the request.
features: Start with a template, automatic edit, photo-to-video idea, or AI reel brief, then carry your own media into a focused editing flow.
Trim on a real timeline, add text and stickers, preview music, detect beats, record voiceover, generate captions, and refine transitions and colour.
Explore guided AI effects, on-device subject cutout, polished export, and Brand Kit workflows built for creators and businesses.
privacyBullets: Photos and videos are edited and exported on the device.
Captions use on-device speech recognition and subject cutout uses Apple Vision.
A private Firebase guest identity saves onboarding choices securely.
Hosted AI names the provider and asks permission before anything is sent.
AI Presenter portraits are deleted automatically within 24 hours.
No advertising, no sale of personal information, and no cross-app tracking.

privacySections.title: On-device creation
paragraphs: ClipAura reads photos and videos only after you grant Photos access. Cutting, transitions, colour filters, captions, subject cutout, timeline editing, and export run on your device. Projects and exported files stay in the app container or in Photos when you choose Save.
Microphone access is used only when you record a voiceover. Speech Recognition access is used for on-device captions. You can change these permissions at any time in iOS Settings.

privacySections.title: Private account and cloud profile
paragraphs: ClipAura automatically creates a private Firebase guest identity so onboarding choices can be saved securely. The cloud profile can include a Firebase user identifier, role, interests, style choices, onboarding progress, and an optional display name.

Sign in with Apple is optional. If you choose it, Firebase Authentication may receive the private relay or other email address Apple provides, along with the name you choose to share. Apple sign-in upgrades the guest identity so the profile can be restored on another device.

privacySections.title: Hosted AI
paragraphs: Before any hosted AI request, ClipAura tells you what will be shared and which company will receive it, and asks for your permission. Nothing is sent until you agree, and you can decline and keep working on the device.

Depending on the feature you choose, your prompt and any reference image, video frame, or audio you select are sent through ClipAura's secured Firebase service to one of four providers: BytePlus, for Seedance video generation and Seedream images; Google, for Gemini video and Imagen images; OpenAI, for GPT Image generation, caption transcription, and prompt suggestions; and D-ID, for AI Presenter videos. Each provider receives only the media and text needed for the request you made, and nothing else from your account.

The service stores the account identifier, model task identifier, timestamps, task status, and daily usage count so it can return the result, resume pending work, and control abuse. Do not submit media you do not have permission to share.

privacySections.title: Face and likeness data
paragraphs: The AI Presenter is the only feature that collects face data, and only if you choose to use it. You either supply a portrait photo or record a short selfie clip with the front camera. When you record a clip, ClipAura extracts one still frame and never retains the recording. That single portrait is stored only on your iPhone, inside the app's own Application Support container. It is not written to your photo library and it is not held on any ClipAura server.

Nothing is uploaded until you ask for a presenter video. When you do, that one portrait frame and your script are sent through ClipAura's secured Firebase service to D-ID, which renders the lip-synced result. D-ID receives the image and the script together with a one-way SHA-256 hash that stands in for your account. Your Firebase identifier, display name, and email address are never sent to D-ID.

The uploaded portrait is stored privately for a maximum of 24 hours so the render can finish and resume if it is interrupted, then a scheduled job deletes it automatically. It is deleted immediately if the render fails, and the whole folder is erased when you delete your ClipAura account. Removing the portrait in the app deletes the local copy straight away.

ClipAura does not use face data to identify or recognise anyone, does not create a face template or faceprint, does not use it to train any model, and does not sell it or share it with anyone other than D-ID for the render you asked for.

Two related features collect no face data at all. Face ID, if you turn on Safe Guard, is handled entirely by iOS: the match happens in the device's Secure Enclave and ClipAura receives only a yes-or-no answer, never any biometric information. Subject cutout uses Apple's on-device Vision framework to separate a subject from its background; it needs no network connection, identifies nobody, and nothing leaves your iPhone.

privacySections.title: Payments
paragraphs: Apple processes subscriptions and payment details. ClipAura receives StoreKit product and entitlement information but never receives your full payment-card details. Subscriptions can be restored in the app and managed in your Apple Account settings.

privacySections.title: Tracking and advertising
paragraphs: ClipAura does not sell personal information, show third-party advertising, or track you across other companies' apps or websites. The app does not use the advertising identifier.

privacySections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local projects remain until you delete them or remove the app. The cloud profile and AI task metadata remain while the private account exists.

A portrait uploaded for an AI Presenter render is kept for at most 24 hours and then deleted automatically. The reusable portrait on your iPhone stays until you replace or remove it, or until you delete the app.

Open Profile, then Account, then Delete ClipAura account to permanently delete the Firebase identity, cloud profile, AI usage, and AI task history. Local projects remain on that device so account deletion does not unexpectedly destroy personal files. App Store subscriptions must be cancelled separately in Apple's subscription settings.

privacySections.title: Children
paragraphs: ClipAura is a general-audience creative tool and is not directed to children under 13. The app does not knowingly collect personal information from a child without the permission required by applicable law.

privacySections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the revised version will be posted here with a new effective date.
For privacy, account-deletion, purchase, or technical questions, email currenttech.co.za@gmail.com. Never send passwords, Apple verification codes, or payment-card details.

measurement: ClipAura records hosted-AI task status, timestamps, and daily usage counts for three reasons: to return a finished result to the device that asked for it, to resume work that was interrupted, and to stop a single account from overwhelming a paid provider. These counts are about requests, not about you: there is no profile built from them, no advertising use, no cross-app or cross-site tracking, and no advertising identifier anywhere in the app. ClipAura does not sell personal information, and no third-party analytics product receives your creative content.
supportIntro: Help with projects, editing, exports, hosted AI, subscriptions, optional Apple sign-in, account deletion, and anything in ClipAura that does not behave as expected.
supportDiagnostic: Include your iPhone model, iOS version, ClipAura version and build, what you were doing, and what the app displayed. Screenshots help. Never send passwords, Apple verification codes, or payment details.

supportCards.title: Subscriptions and Restore Purchases
supportCards.body: Open Profile and tap Subscription to see Creator, Studio, and Agency with your App Store's localized monthly prices. Restore Purchases is at the bottom of the paywall. Manage or cancel a subscription in iOS Settings under your Apple Account and Subscriptions.

supportCards.title: A product or price does not load
supportCards.body: Confirm the device is online, reopen the Subscription screen, and try again. Prices come directly from Apple's StoreKit and can vary by country or region. Do not purchase if the price or renewal period is not shown clearly.

supportCards.title: Projects and exports
supportCards.body: Projects stay on the device. Saving to Photos requires Photos Add permission and enough free storage. If an export fails, include the chosen resolution, number of clips, and the message ClipAura displayed.

supportCards.title: Hosted AI did not complete
supportCards.body: Hosted AI requires your consent, an internet connection, and an input accepted by the provider's safety rules. Pending jobs can resume after relaunch. A refusal does not use a successful render result.

supportCards.title: Optional Apple sign-in
supportCards.body: ClipAura works with a private guest identity and does not require login. Sign in with Apple is optional and lets the onboarding profile be restored on another Apple device.

supportCards.title: Delete the cloud account
supportCards.body: Open Profile, Account, and Delete ClipAura account. This deletes the Firebase identity, cloud profile, AI usage, and task history. Local projects stay on the device. Cancel subscriptions separately in Apple's subscription settings.

termsSections.title: Licence and Apple terms
paragraphs: ClipAura is licensed, not sold. Apple's Standard End User License Agreement applies to the app. These product terms explain ClipAura-specific services and do not replace rights you have under applicable law.

termsSections.title: Monthly subscriptions
paragraphs: Creator, Studio, and Agency are monthly auto-renewable subscriptions sold through Apple. The price and renewal period shown by StoreKit at purchase are controlling. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.

A subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings. Access continues through the paid period after cancellation.

termsSections.title: Tier access
paragraphs: Creator includes premium templates, 4K export, watermark removal, and AI captions. Studio adds advanced AI effects, subject cutout, and Pro transitions. Agency adds Business Reel and Brand Kit workflows. Product availability may depend on device capability, internet access, and third-party service availability.

termsSections.title: Your content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of content you create. You are responsible for having permission to use media, music, logos, prompts, and other inputs you provide, and for checking the finished output before publishing it.

termsSections.title: Hosted AI
paragraphs: Hosted AI is optional and starts only after a disclosure and consent step. Results may be unavailable, delayed, refused by provider safety systems, or unsuitable for your intended use. Review generated output before relying on or publishing it.

termsSections.title: Accounts and deletion
paragraphs: ClipAura creates a private guest identity for cloud profile persistence. Sign in with Apple is optional. Deleting the ClipAura account removes server-side identity, profile, AI usage, and task history, but does not cancel an Apple subscription or delete local projects.

termsSections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about ClipAura or these terms can be sent to currenttech.co.za@gmail.com.

dataIntro: This page sets out every category of information ClipAura touches, why it is needed, where it goes, and how long it lasts. It is a companion to the privacy policy rather than a replacement: the policy is the binding document, and this page is the plain-language version of the same facts.

The shape of the app is that ordinary creative work never leaves your iPhone. Trimming, transitions, colour, captions, subject cutout, timeline edits, and export all run locally, so most of what you make is never uploaded at all. Information leaves the device in only three situations: you sign in, you buy something, or you ask a hosted AI model to generate something for you.

Hosted AI is the only one of those that sends your creative content anywhere, and it never happens silently. Before the first request to any provider, ClipAura names the company that will receive your data and what it will receive, and waits for you to agree. If you decline, the feature stops and everything else in the app keeps working.

Replace or delete your reusable portrait at any time, which removes the local copy immediately.
Revoke Photos, Microphone, Camera, and Speech Recognition access at any time in iOS Settings.
